appraisal_events.evidence: « Ah ! lui, ce n'est pas comme toi, c'est une si belle chose, si grande, si jolie, que son amitié pour moi. Ce n'est pas lui qui me considérerait assez peu pour vouloir se montrer avec moi dans tous les lieux publics »
appraisal_events.explanation: Odette praises Adolphe's friendship in exalted terms and contrasts his discretion favorably with Swann, elevating him locally, though her 'poetic airs' suggest the praise may be rhetorical or self-serving rather than sincere.

status_effects.explanation: Odette holds Adolphe up as an exemplary, trusted friend, favorably distinguishing him from Swann in the same breath she uses to rebuff Swann (already captured in the accepted annotation).

ambiguities: Odette's praise of oncle Adolphe is delivered with 'des airs poétiques,' which may signal performative or self-serving exaggeration rather than sincere admiration; the positive stance toward Adolphe is treated conservatively.
